insight: Founded in 2023 by ex-Monzo employees; it expanded its Series A to $26M (Redpoint) and serves fintechs reaching 32M+ end users.
name: Gradient Labs
tagline: AI agents that handle complex customer support in regulated industries.
description: Gradient Labs builds AI agents that resolve customer support and operations queries — disputes, KYC, lending and account questions — for banks, fintechs and other regulated businesses. Its agents learn a company's own products and procedures so they can handle nuanced cases end-to-end rather than deflecting to a human. Founded by early Monzo employees, it focuses on the accuracy and safety needed for high-stakes financial conversations.
edge: Built for regulated finance: its agents learn company-specific procedures to resolve disputes, KYC and lending queries safely, not just FAQ deflection.
